Write a BIDS derivative recording

Source: R/io-bids-motion.R
writeBIDSDerivative.Rd

Writes x as a derivative under deriv_root with a desc-<label> entity, and a derivative dataset_description.json whose GeneratedBy is populated from the object's provenance (provenance). The signals are stored as a gzipped _physio.tsv.gz plus JSON.

Usage

writeBIDSDerivative(
  x,
  deriv_root,
  subject,
  task,
  desc,
  session = NULL,
  run = NULL,
  pipeline_name = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

A PhysioExperiment (typically a processed derivative).

deriv_root

Derivative dataset root (e.g. "<bids>/derivatives/physio-clean").

subject, task, session, run

BIDS entities.

desc

The desc- label (e.g. "clean").

pipeline_name

Name recorded in GeneratedBy (default basename(deriv_root)).

overwrite

Overwrite existing files (default FALSE).

Value

The written data path, invisibly.

See also

readBIDSDerivatives
